records.name: Orchestra 2001, Inc.
records.summary: An ensemble that plays 20th and 21st century music. Its community work includes free and pay-what-you-wish pop-up concerts at markets and public events.
records.what_you_do: Go to a free pop-up concert or a public concert, sign up for e-news, or ask about volunteering, an internship, or the board through the Support page.

schedule.text: Pop-up and public concerts through the year. Recent dated events: Sept 24, 2026 jazz duo at Fairmount Farmers Market, and Oct 3, 2026 Firstival at Eastern State Penitentiary (free, 10 am to 2 pm, with pop-ups 11:30 am to 12:30 pm).

cost.text: Some events are free or pay-what-you-wish; others are ticketed. Prices vary by event.

first_step.how: Go to the next free pop-up concert listed on the events page, or send a volunteer or internship question through the Support page.
first_step.basis: Free public concerts need no sign-up, but the site does not describe how volunteers or interns are chosen.

records.notes: The events list includes older 2022 to 2025 items. The Playing the Markets 2025 to 2026 pop-ups are undated. No instrument tag fits the ensemble, so interests are left empty.
